title: Settings window: choose the visual world
question: Same structure on every card (live stick + M-speed state on top, Display studio open, Input / M-speed / Research collapsed). Pick the look, or re-roll.

options.label: Console System Menu
options.lineage: Late-90s Sega console system/settings menus (Dreamcast era, Sonic Adventure's home)
options.thesis: The settings window as a console's own system menu: pale, friendly, chunky rounded type, one orange that only ever means M-speed.
materials: rounded geometric sans (M PLUS Rounded 1c, OFL)
options.viewport: A memory-card style LCD tile at the top shows the live stick, the 0.265 deadzone square and the M-speed ring lighting orange; collapsible white panels below, Display studio open with segmented choices and a button-set cell grid.
options.risk: Light theme next to a dark OBS setup; the LCD tile reads as nostalgia if it's drawn too literally. No Sega logos or swirl used.

raised.raise: Orange is reserved for one job: the M-speed ring and state. Nothing else on the window is orange.
Button sets and toons are picked from a cell grid of thumbnails, whole-cell selection, not a dropdown.
Values sit in one fixed right-hand column across every panel, so the eye never hunts.
Control states are distinct marks: outlined at rest, filled when chosen, struck through when unavailable (e.g. game value with no game).

options.label: Split Timer
options.thesis: Settings read like splits: dark rows, values in a monospaced right column, changed-from-default values green like time saved, M-speed in timer gold.
materials: Barlow / Barlow Semi Condensed + JetBrains Mono (OFL)
options.viewport: Stick plot with ring and deadzone beside a big monospaced live game distance (0.052) like a running timer; ruled rows below.
options.risk: The most familiar choice for this audience and close to the default dark ImGui look, so it can blend into OBS's own docks.

options.label: Split-flap Concourse
options.case: Fuses poorly: a settings form isn't a ranked live board; runners don't identify with it.
options.kept: Fixed value column that never moves.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.case: Only the asset picker fits; the rest of the window would be costume.
options.kept: Finite roster picked by whole cells (button sets, toons).

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.case: Mobile thumb patterns don't fit a desktop tool window.
options.kept: Accent color only on things that act.

options.label: Centre-rail Reference
options.case: A reading layout, not a control panel.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.case: Nothing in the settings has magnitude data to carry.
options.kept: Nothing beyond the coordinate plot the stick already has.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.case: Decision-point signage doesn't map to a settings list.
options.kept: One color reserved for one job.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean dark ImGui/OBS-dock style panel, done carefully.
